reason: The early return silences the warning for empty lists, but calling len() before normalizing the input breaks scalar conversion, as the failing test_convert_one_number confirms.
Evaluating marks after the test catches the reported dynamic xfail, but it can also reverse a previously evaluated condition, and two newly added tests would report ordinary failures when collected.
Using str() preserves 0.009125, but the formatter expands 1E-07 to 1.0E-07, which can newly truncate a long HIERARCH comment, a case the five recorded tests do not cover.

get_feature_names() now validates the supplied vocabulary on first use, but the shared vocabulary check also accepts a configured vectorizer with no vocabulary_ attribute, a state the recorded tests do not exercise.
